caption: The video captures a wide, low-angle view of a massive horseshoe-shaped waterfall beneath a bright blue sky dotted with cumulus clouds. A continuous sheet of pale water pours over the crest and falls into a thick white mist cloud rising from the base. Above the falls, the cloud forms remain mostly steady, while the water curtain keeps advancing downward across the upper frame. In the foreground, a churning pool of pale-green water is covered with shifting white foam, swirls, and eddies. The cascade itself is already in motion and continues without pause throughout the visible excerpt. The central mist plume churns and changes shape, sometimes bulging higher and sometimes spreading wider as vapor swirls near the impact zone. The foam patterns on the pool surface rearrange continuously, showing turbulent currents rather than a settled or still surface. A slight apparent camera drift moves the clouds and crest a little relative to the edges of the view, while the waterfall remains the dominant visible process.
